title: Tic Tac videos seen in the Pentagon before release; better videos exist

tellings.quote: tac videos that are so well known lou elizondo was behind releasing those videos i remember seeing them in the pentagon before they were released but there are more videos some are better

plain: The Navy videos of the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint, were seen inside the Pentagon before they were released in 2017, and there are more videos, some better, according to the physicist Hal Puthoff, who worked on government studies of psychic abilities and UFOs. He tells Michels he remembers seeing them there and that Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who ran a small office studying unexplained aerial reports, "was behind releasing those videos". If true, the government holds clearer footage than anything the public has seen.
